entries.title: Job 14:1
segments: ¶Man [that is] born of a woman [is] of few days, and full of trouble. {few...: Heb. short of days}

entries.title: Job 14:2
segments: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

entries.title: Job 14:3
segments: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

entries.title: Job 14:4
segments: Who can bring a clean [thing] out of an unclean? not one. {can...: Heb. will give}

entries.title: Job 14:5
segments: Seeing his days [are] determined, the number of his months [are] with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

entries.title: Job 14:6
segments: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day. {rest: Heb. cease}

words.text: from him, that he may rest

entries.title: Job 14:7
segments: ¶For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

entries.title: Job 14:8
segments: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

entries.title: Job 14:9
segments: [Yet] through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

entries.title: Job 14:10
segments: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where [is] he? {wasteth...: Heb. is weakened, or, cut off}

words.text: , and where [is] he? {wasteth...: Heb. is weakened, or, cut off}

entries.title: Job 14:11
segments: [As] the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

entries.title: Job 14:12
segments: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens [be] no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

entries.title: Job 14:13
segments: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

words.text: , that thou wouldest keep me secret

entries.title: Job 14:14
segments: If a man die, shall he live [again]? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

entries.title: Job 14:15
segments: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

words.text: thee: thou wilt have a desire

entries.title: Job 14:16
segments: ¶For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

entries.title: Job 14:17
segments: My transgression [is] sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

entries.title: Job 14:18
segments: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place. {cometh...: Heb. fadeth}

entries.title: Job 14:19
segments: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow [out] of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man. {washest...: Heb. overflowest}

entries.title: Job 14:20
segments: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

entries.title: Job 14:21
segments: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth [it] not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth [it] not of them.

words.text: [it] not; and they are brought low

entries.title: Job 14:22
segments: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
